title: Continuous but not differentiable
back: $y=\lvert x-1\rvert$ has no break at $x=1$, but the slope jumps from $-1$ to $+1$: a corner. Continuity does not imply differentiability.

title: Continuity at x = a
back: Three values, one number. For "find $k$", equate them.

title: Differentiability at x = a
back: LHD = RHD, both finite. Differentiable ⇒ continuous, but not the other way round.

title: Chain rule
back: Differentiate the outside, keep the inside, then multiply by the derivative of the inside.

title: Derivatives of sin⁻¹x and cos⁻¹x
back: $\cos^{-1}x$ has the same derivative with a minus sign. Simplify with a substitution before differentiating when you can.

title: Derivatives of tan⁻¹x and cot⁻¹x
back: $\cot^{-1}x$: the same with a minus sign. $\sec^{-1}x$: $\dfrac{1}{\lvert x\rvert\sqrt{x^2-1}}$.

title: Implicit differentiation
back: Differentiate every term with respect to $x$; each $y$ term brings a $\dfrac{dy}{dx}$. Collect those terms and solve.

title: Derivative of uᵛ
back: Take logs first, then differentiate. Special case: $\dfrac{d}{dx}x^x=x^x(1+\log x)$.

title: Parametric: first derivative
back: Differentiate both with respect to $t$, then divide.

title: Parametric: second derivative
back: Not $\dfrac{d^2y/dt^2}{d^2x/dt^2}$. Differentiate $\dfrac{dy}{dx}$ with respect to $t$ and divide by $\dfrac{dx}{dt}$.
